metrics.name: Checkout Completion Rate
metrics.description_hint: % of users who start checkout and complete purchase.
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{end_event}' THEN {user_col} END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN {event_col} = '{start_event}' THEN {user_col} END), 0), 1) AS checkout_completion_rate_pct FROM {table}

metrics.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
metrics.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(AVG({numeric_col}), 2) AS aov FROM {table} WHERE {event_col} = '{matched_event}' AND {numeric_col} > 0
